messages:
Tara (Events): Quick heads up — we need to swap the order: roadmap first, then product demos. Prod asked for 5 extra mins. Can speakers accept?
Alex (Presenter): I can move to after the demos, no problem.
Sam (Product): Thanks — need to surface a one-liner about Dedicated capacity expansion. simple: 'Expanding Dedicated footprint to reduce regional latency and support compliance.' want shorter?
Eve (CEO): Good. Shorten to: 'Expanding Dedicated regions this quarter to improve latency & compliance.'
Tara (Events): Perfect. AV note: Brynn, how's the recording situation? we had a flaky capture during last rehearsal.
Brynn (AV): ops-bot flagged disk saturation on capture-1 earlier. I'm switching to capture-2 and forcing low-bitrate backup for preview viewers.
ops-bot: alert: capture-1 disk utilization 98% at 1766214315
Brynn (AV): command run: ```ssh av@capture-2 'sudo systemctl start stream-capture && /usr/local/bin/set-bitrate 1500'```
Mateo (Eng): I'll mirror the stream endpoint and update the CDN origin to capture-2. Pushing change now.
Mateo (Eng): cdn update applied, origin -> capture-2 :ok_hand:
Tara (Events): mic check in 3. Alex, can you confirm you've got headset B? last time we heard a hum.
Alex (Presenter): on headset B, volume at 65%. No hum.
Brynn (AV): verified audio levels, but captions are delayed ~7s on the backup source. call it out when you mention Q&A.
Tara (Events): noted — will tell folks captions lag. Also timeline: we'll keep recording +90s after session end for handoffs.
Sam (Product): quick Q for leadership during Q&A: will Dedicated be part of self-serve or enterprise-only? can we get a one-liner?
Eve (CEO): Plan is hybrid — self-serve pilot for small teams, enterprise contracts for committed capacity. I'll phrase during Q&A.
Mateo (Eng): small ops note — archive job sometimes misses the last 30s if stop-recorder triggers immediately. can we hold stop by 90s?
Tara (Events): yes that's the plan. stop+90s.
ops-bot: recording: started capture-2-backup at 1766214340
Brynn (AV): OBS reattached to capture-2, local iso recording ok. monitor watchers reporting stable.
Tara (Events): For follow-ups: please prefix any post-show asks with "followup:" in #post-allhands and include owner. I'll compile a list and assign.
Sam (Product): noted. I'll drop the slide and a short FAQ in #product after the presentation.
Eve (CEO): During intros I'll mention where to file security/compliance follow-ups and the timeline for roadmap details.
Tara (Events): Great — wrapping preflight. everyone ready?
Alex (Presenter): ready. let's go. :rocket:
